brief_summary: Three-panel process strip for double-shot molding. Panel one shows the legend cavity with an ochre 'A' plug on a thin backing plate (shot 1). Panel two shows a cap-shaped cross-section cavity with hatched body plastic flooding around the carried-over ochre insert (shot 2). Panel three zooms on the finished top wall with the ochre legend column running the full 1.5 mm thickness and a dashed wear line showing more legend beneath the surface.
data_sources: how-keycaps-are-made-deep-dive.mdx § 'Double-shot: the legend is a second shot' — 'Shot one fills a mold whose cavity is the legend: a solid plug of, say, white ABS in the shape of an "A", sitting on a thin backing plate. Shot two moves that insert into a second cavity shaped like the finished cap and floods it with the body colour.'
